【OIA】GENDER EQUALITY in CAMPUS
Culture Differences? Culture Shock?

This talk will explore how gender equality is understood and experienced across different cultures on campus.
We’ll discuss how cultural backgrounds can shape our views on gender roles, and how these differences might lead to misunderstandings or even culture shock.
Join us for an open and engaging discussion!
